budget_policy: A 64 MiB aggregate working-tree review threshold, excluding Git administration. A threshold breach remains a failed capacity check and never authorizes deletion of required state, configuration, selected deliverables or recovery evidence.
scope: Paths are relative to the exact initialized PRIVATE companion Git root. Defaults use root-level state/, agent-runs/ and digest.json; the sole reminder DB and action workspace use data/. Explicit environment overrides need reviewed path families and PRIVATE write proof. Known writer leaves are declared; arbitrary action-workspace outputs require owner-action and selected-output manifest review and remain gaps until classified.

artifacts.purpose: Active relay, ingest and command configuration, including private credentials.
artifacts.schema: skills/schedule-reminder/reference/agent-center.md and scripts/relay.py.
artifacts.producer: agent_center_admin.py and reviewed operator configuration.
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: Relay delivery, inbound polling and registered commands.
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Restore the selected private configuration and validate live credentials separately.

retention_rule.rule: Keep the active configuration and versions needed to interpret unresolved deliveries; retain history in PRIVATE storage.

artifacts.purpose: Routing configuration retained for installed integrations.
artifacts.schema: The installed route consumer owns this schema; this source does not validate its contents.
artifacts.producer: Reviewed integration configuration.
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: The installed routing integration and operator recovery.
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Restore the approved private version; confirm the consuming integration before changing it.

retention_rule.rule: Preserve until consumer and recovery dependencies have been reviewed.

artifacts.purpose: Durable tasks, alarms, transitions, operation generations, creation/action/link receipts and notification identities, including SQLite sidecars.
artifacts.schema: scripts/store.py and reference/contract.md.
artifacts.producer: reminder.py and store.py.
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: The stable reminder CLI and scheduled workers.
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Use SQLite's backup API or a cold checkpointed snapshot; do not restore a live WAL database by copying only its main file.

retention_rule.rule: Retain current state and required audit history. Remove sidecars only through SQLite or after a verified cold shutdown.

artifacts.purpose: Most recent worker identity and measured delivery receipts.

artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: A real successful worker delivery regenerates evidence; copied or synthetic receipts cannot establish external readiness.

retention_rule.rule: Retain the latest measured evidence; freshness is evaluated by health, independently of storage retention.

artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: Configuration setup and recovery.

artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: Versioned PRIVATE runtime storage.

retention_rule.rule: Keep current tracking rules. Transient locks may be ignored only when their durable owners remain versionable.

retention_rule.rule: Review at 1 MiB; retain current diagnostics and unresolved failures, then rotate only after checking the active writer.

retention_rule.rule: Keep only while integration or rollback remains unresolved; remove after final verification and explicit maintenance authorization. Do not accumulate a parallel archive of source history.

artifacts.purpose: Temporary holding area for explicitly reviewed inactive development artifacts awaiting authorized removal.

retention_rule.rule: Remove after the exact removal action is authorized and inactivity is rechecked. Relocation is not disk reclamation and does not make development outputs core state.

retention_rule.rule: Keep complete original history; absent old IDs never imply reactivation.

artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Restore D102 consistent SQLite snapshot or original archive into a historical import only.

artifacts.purpose: Historical console observation database and SQLite sidecars; current console binding uses its separate companion.

artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Restore a consistent private SQLite snapshot; console schema does not promise complete reconstruction from JSONL.

retention_rule.rule: No new development writes. Hold until useful unique code, required DATA, selected results, registration and rollback evidence are extracted into their owning current families; reconcile incomplete transactions, consumer/process dependencies and SQLite state. Retirement requires verified inactivity and a separately authorized concrete removal plan. This classification asserts neither completed closure nor present removability.

artifacts.purpose: Historical owner-database upgrade, isolated acceptance, registration and launcher staging outputs.

artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Restore only matching private SQLite snapshots, launcher bindings and registration journal/receipt identities; do not run a candidate DB as another live scheduler.

artifacts.purpose: Selected diagnostic evidence or reproducer for a reviewed owner-linked action.
artifacts.schema: Private owner-action selection manifest, evidence/delivery.json artifact hashes and the named diagnostic format.
artifacts.producer: Reviewed diagnostic action and its retained offline evidence utilities.
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: The matching owner review, selected diagnostic conclusion and unresolved recovery.
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Restore the selected bytes and manifest from PRIVATE history with their matching owner identities and source revision; never replay a production action to rebuild evidence.

retention_rule.rule: Keep owner-linked, hash-selected diagnostic reports, reproducers and receipt evidence while the matching work, review or recovery is unresolved. The path family is eligibility for selected evidence, not automatic selection of every same-named output. Preserve the private owner-action linkage, selected-output manifest, source revision and required workspace reconciliation before retirement. A delivery receipt proves artifact provenance; it does not prove work completion or current runtime success.
